title.narrative: Livable, Resilient, and Water-Secure Cities Investment Program (Tranche 1)

description.narrative: The proposed program will support the Government of Cambodia's efforts in achieving its targeted urban and water resilience, economic growth, poverty reduction, and sustainable development goals (SDGs). It will support priority short- to long-term investments to (i) improve, expand, and sustain resilient urban areas, infrastructure, and services; (ii) promote water security in 10 cities and 2 districts across the Mekong, Tonle Sap, and coastal regions; and (iii) foster reforms and institutional strengthening of service providers
